description: Takes a doc out of the playbook, with every version it ever had. This is FINAL and there is no trash: Iris stops reading it from the next draft on. A doc that is merely out of date is better rewritten with update_knowledge, which keeps the previous version dated in its history.

doc_id.description: The id of the doc, as list_knowledge gives it.

name: delete_knowledge
title: Remove a knowledge doc
